notes: `מִפְּנֵי` fuses to *before* under rule 30's compound-preposition case, headed on the construct noun per rule 23, with the suffix taking its own *you*.
*maketh to perish* heads on the complement *perish* (rule 44); the written `כֵּן` takes the apodosis *so*, which is the contrasting shape to the added *so* of DEU.8.5.
Both paragogic nuns are unrepresented (rule 32), and the construct `קוֹל` takes the supplied *the* with `יְהוָה` taking *of* (rules 29 and 19).
